---
title: "Evidence Packets"
---

Evidence packets are human-readable views of linked source, document, segment,
proposition, annotation, negative-evidence, and rival-explanation records.

The JSONL files under `projects/sacrificial-debt/data/` remain canonical. These
pages are derived review surfaces and should be updated in lock-step when the
underlying packet records change.

## Available Packets

| Packet | Status | Role | Canonical records |
|---|---|---|---|
| [sd-packet-000001](sd-packet-000001.qmd) | Project-owner reviewed calibration | Tests a negative/qualifying evidence chain for Judenzaehlung contribution claims. | `sd-src-ger-segall-jewish-soldiers-1922`, `sd-doc-000001`, `sd-seg-000001`, `sd-prop-000001`, `sd-ann-000001`, `sd-neg-000001`, `sd-rival-000001` |

## Packet Rules

- Packets do not promote claims.
- Packets do not replace canonical JSONL.
- Review status must remain visible.
- Coordinate scope and locator notes must remain visible.
- Limitations and rival explanations should appear next to supporting or
  qualifying evidence.
